verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's DGX B300 docs publish system-level tensor throughput with the precision stated: 72 PFLOPS FP8 for training and 144 PFLOPS FP4 for inference. The headline figures do not say whether they are dense or sparse. 'Dense FP4' appears only as a relative 1.5x claim versus B200, and a community comment alludes to INT8/FP64 spec changes without first-party numbers. missing for 10: dense-vs-sparse labeling on the absolute TFLOPS figures, per-GPU throughput tables, a full set of precisions (FP16/BF16/TF32/INT8/FP64), independent corroboration.
